purpose: Rank current CAGR/MDD bottlenecks without tuning or opening an unqualified A/B.
selection_edge_rule: selected-minus-missed mean and median SPY excess return must be positive at 21, 63, and 126 trading days for each portfolio
broad_cash_redeploy_rule: cash-rejected missed leaders must have positive mean and median 63-day SPY excess return in each portfolio
generic_exit_delay_rule: sold-minus-replacement mean and median return must be positive at both 63 and 126 trading days in each portfolio
execution_or_risk_overlay_rule: delta CAGR and delta MDD versus broker baseline must both be nonnegative in each portfolio
historical_ab_rule: next-single-A/B readiness must explicitly open one source-screened arm
forward_risk_rule: risk outcome archive must meet its frozen mechanism-review gate before any action arm
